correctness.rationale: Fully specified atomic measure produces bounded Gram G=K+E; K is the positive hyperbolic-secant Toeplitz matrix and E is exponentially approximable by finite rank. An explicit weighted Toeplitz counting proof through banded approximation, block localization and finite Toeplitz trace moments gives N(t) asymptotics; Weyl inequalities remove E. The positive coefficient and eigenvalue asymptotics entail the quasi-Schatten and logarithmic endpoint. Numerical finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Geometrically clustered positive atomic moments are a natural critical-boundary model in Dirichlet-series Hilbert spaces. Exact \(n^{-r}\) eigenvalue coefficient and all Schatten thresholds, including weak critical residue, go beyond general trace tests and reveal \(q\)-dependent correlations; the cases \(r=1\) and \(r=\tfrac12\) give explicit natural constants. No arbitrary finite slice, mere normalization or known-table recomputation is asserted.
